Worth knowing before Haukland Beach
PHaukland practical note
Official Visit Lofoten information lists a modern visitor centre, café, toilets and expanded parking. Current parking is 20 NOK/hour with the first 20 minutes free; registration/payment should be done immediately. The café is listed 10:00–19:00 from Aug 16 through May 31. Recent Tripadvisor reviews remain very strong (4.6/5).

Worth knowing before Lofotr Viking Museum
VLofotr timing / admission
For Sep 13, the museum's official 2026 schedule is 10:00–17:00 daily (Aug 16–Sep 15). Adult admission 265 NOK; senior/student 225 NOK. The reconstructed longhouse is the core experience; the harbour is a 25–30 minute walk each way.

Worth knowing before Delft historic centre
WDelft: walk, don't over-schedule
Delft's official tourism site emphasizes that the historic centre is compact and major sights are within walking distance. Oude Delft is the city's oldest canal (around 1100), passing the leaning Oude Kerk, courtyards and historic buildings. Museum Prinsenhof remains closed for renovation, so a canal-and-street walk is the better low-friction choice.
Offline research note · InDelft official tourism
